chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan from Ibn Abi Umayr from Mansur ibn Hazim said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the expiation of the independent Umrah, where it should be performed? He said: 'In Mecca, unless its owner wishes to delay it to Mina, but making it in Mecca is more beloved to me and superior.'

For this report is a concession for what is obligatory of the expiation in the case of non-game, but as for what is obligatory in the expiation of game, then it is not slaughtered except in Mecca. That is indicated by what has been narrated:

key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ الْمُفْرَدَةُ: Independent Umrah (Umrah performed separately from Hajj)
key_terms.رُخْصَة: Concession or ease in religious law
key_terms.كَفَّارَة: Expiation or compensation for a ritual omission or violation
key_terms.كَفَّارَة الصَّيْدِ: Expiation for hunting game while in Ihram

ai.seo_question: Where should the expiation for an independent Umrah be performed according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the geographical scope of expiation (*kaffarah*) for an independent Umrah, permitting it in Mecca or delayed to Mina, with Mecca being the preferred location. The text explicitly contrasts this flexibility with the stricter rule for expiation of hunting (*kaffarat al-sayd*), which mandates slaughter within the sacred precincts of Mecca, highlighting the distinction between general ritual penalties and specific hunting violations. This ruling underscores the jurisprudential nuance in Shia fiqh regarding the sanctity of locations relative to the type of ritual breach.
